records.claim_text: Event planning should fit the scale and risks, clarify responsibility, and consider audience, place, duration, facilities and suitable contractors.
records.review_mode: Selected primary sections inspected; researcher applications distinguished from publisher statements.
records.interpretation_limits: HSE guidance is used for proportionate organising work, not a bespoke legal opinion or a requirement to reproduce festival staffing.

records.locator: Management; competence; monitoring; after an event
records.claim_text: Organising includes coordination and competent oversight during relevant phases and a post-event review. The guidance allows a simple checklist for small-scale events.
records.review_mode: Selected primary sections inspected; researcher applications distinguished from publisher statements.
records.interpretation_limits: Venue staff do not automatically own all organiser tasks. Actual responsibilities and competent available people must be established.

records.claim_text: Advance rail tickets are restricted to the specified date/train and limited availability. Changes can incur a fee and fare difference; ordinary refunds are restricted, with disruption exceptions.
records.review_mode: Selected primary sections inspected; researcher applications distinguished from publisher statements.
records.interpretation_limits: No route fare, universal cheapest option or blanket no-refund rule adopted. Check the actual ticket and travel dates.

records.claim_text: Rail assistance offers a route to arrange travel support, including multi-service journeys; actual requirements and station/train arrangements need checking.
records.review_mode: Selected primary sections inspected; researcher applications distinguished from publisher statements.
records.interpretation_limits: No personal disability data, support booking, universal accessibility guarantee or cost saving inferred.

records.claim_text: HMRC mileage guidance concerns tax treatment of employee business-vehicle payments. It does not establish JGA reimbursement policy, a fare quote or a complete journey cost.
records.review_mode: Selected primary sections inspected; researcher applications distinguished from publisher statements.
records.interpretation_limits: No numeric tax rate adopted as an event input. Actual payer, eligibility, date, policy and reimbursement amount remain unknown.

records.claim_text: Eventbrite states that free-ticket events have no ticketing-platform fee, while paid-ticket handling and optional tools can involve charges.
records.review_mode: Selected primary sections inspected; researcher applications distinguished from publisher statements.
records.interpretation_limits: No platform is selected. Free software does not remove invitation, privacy, moderation or support work; no paid-fee percentage adopted.

records.locator: PDF pp2-4 and p6: relationships, process and outcomes
records.claim_text: The IAF framework separates agreed roles and deliverables, process design, participation and useful outcomes. This supports treating moderator preparation and follow-through as work alongside live facilitation.
records.review_mode: Selected primary sections inspected; researcher applications distinguished from publisher statements.
records.interpretation_limits: No certification, JGA capability, freelance fee, universal staff ratio or fixed preparation multiple is implied. Relevant competency text inspected; the group-process and participation pages were visually checked.

records.locator: Researcher application to T04 venue evidence and T05S refinements
records.claim_text: Practitioner seats, additional distinct team/guest seats, confirmed attendance, attendance on the day and billed covers require separate counts. A person with two roles occupies one place.
records.review_mode: Selected primary sections inspected; researcher applications distinguished from publisher statements.
records.interpretation_limits: Constructed count examples are not recruited participants or evidence of actual attendance.

records.locator: Researcher application to minimum, charges and deposit mechanics
records.claim_text: Use the actual minimum-spend offset, eligible consumption and charge bases. A credited deposit changes cash and balance, rather than adding a second expense.
records.review_mode: Selected primary sections inspected; researcher applications distinguished from publisher statements.
records.interpretation_limits: Venue-specific rules remain unquoted. No blanket tax recovery, charge base or future rate is adopted.

records.claim_text: Invitation and change work can occur without a completed event. Track incurred work, remaining work and supplier liabilities separately from completed-session counts.
records.review_mode: Selected primary sections inspected; researcher applications distinguished from publisher statements.
records.interpretation_limits: No no-show probability, cancellation rate, guaranteed turnout or loss provision is estimated.

records.claim_text: Count each person's required task time once. A moderator package may include preparation, travel or notes; avoid adding the same cash or resource cost again when integrating a quote.
records.review_mode: Selected primary sections inspected; researcher applications distinguished from publisher statements.
records.interpretation_limits: This component does not value labour or combine a staffing package with its included hourly resources.

records.locator: Researcher application to journey and currency scope
records.claim_text: Travel is scoped by traveller, route, date, mode, payer, flexibility and necessary accommodation. Keep staff travel time separate from fares and avoid duplicating work done during travel.
records.review_mode: Selected primary sections inspected; researcher applications distinguished from publisher statements.
records.interpretation_limits: No origin, Texas city, fare, hotel, per diem, foreign exchange rate or reimbursement promise is assumed.
